name: com.mofcloud/pricing
title: MofCloud Pricing MCP
description: Free daily list prices for servers, GPUs, disks, egress, IPs and databases across 15 clouds.

tools.name: compare_bandwidth
tools.description: Compare fixed-bandwidth (按带宽) cost across clouds: the monthly USD cost of an N-Mbps public pipe from a region, tier-accumulated ($/Mbps is tiered, typically flat to 5 Mbps then steeper). charge_type 'subscription' (包月, default) or 'on_demand' (按量按小时, scaled ×730 to a month so both compare on one axis). This is the alternative to pay-by-traffic (compare_egress): a fixed pipe is cheaper for steady high-throughput, egress for bursty/low volume. Filter by provider/region/country/continent/near; cheapest first.

country.description: ISO country code, e.g. US, SG

continent.description: NA, SA, EU, AS, AF, or OC

near.description: free-text place to find nearby regions, e.g. Singapore

mbps.description: fixed bandwidth in Mbps to price (default 100)

charge_type.description: 'subscription' (monthly, default) or 'on_demand' (hourly, scaled to a month)

tools.name: compare_disk_providers
tools.description: For a disk requirement (category and/or min_iops), return the single cheapest disk from EACH cloud provider, ordered cheapest-first. Best for 'which cloud has the cheapest SSD sustaining 50k IOPS'.

country.description: ISO country code, e.g. US, CN, SG

continent.description: NA, SA, EU, AS, AF, or OC

near.description: free-text place to find nearby regions, e.g. Singapore

category.description: disk tier: hdd, standard_ssd, balanced_ssd, perf_ssd, or ultra

disk_type.description: raw disk type substring, e.g. gp3, cloud_essd_pl1, ESSD

min_iops.description: only disk types whose max IOPS >= this (avoid DB/RDS bottleneck)

min_throughput_mbps.description: only disk types whose max throughput (MBps) >= this

max_gib_month_usd.description: max price in USD per GiB per month

tools.name: compare_egress
tools.description: Compare internet egress (出网流量/按流量) cost across clouds: the monthly USD cost of sending volume_gb/month to the public internet from a region, tier-accumulated (egress is tiered, so a single $/GB understates it). Egress is often the hidden #1 cost — a cheap server with pricey egress can lose to a pricier one. Filter by provider/region/country/continent/near; returns cheapest regions first. Add to a server's monthly cost for the true bill. Use this for pay-by-traffic; use compare_bandwidth for a fixed Mbps pipe.

country.description: ISO country code, e.g. US, SG

continent.description: NA, SA, EU, AS, AF, or OC

near.description: free-text place to find nearby regions, e.g. Singapore

volume_gb.description: monthly egress to the internet in GB to price (default 1024 = 1 TB)

tools.name: compare_eip
tools.description: Compare the monthly USD cost of a public IP (EIP/弹性公网IP) across clouds, per region. Default scope 'eip_bound' = the IP cost while ATTACHED to a running instance: AWS/GCP/Azure charge ~$3.65/mo ($0.005/h) for every public IPv4, and Volcengine/UCloud charge a smaller fee; clouds ABSENT from the result give a bound IP for FREE (AlibabaCloud, TencentCloud, BaiduCloud, Huawei standard EIP) — absent means free, not missing data. Scope 'eip_idle' instead returns the penalty rate for an unbound/reserved IP. Pair with compare_egress + compare_bandwidth for a server's full public-network cost.

country.description: ISO country code, e.g. US, SG

continent.description: NA, SA, EU, AS, AF, or OC

near.description: free-text place to find nearby regions, e.g. Singapore

scope.description: 'eip_bound' (default, IP attached to a running instance) or 'eip_idle' (unbound/reserved penalty rate)

tools.name: compare_providers
tools.description: For a given machine shape (vCPU/memory/GPU/charge-type), return the single cheapest instance from EACH cloud provider, ordered cheapest-first. Best for 'which cloud is cheapest for X'. Dedicated-core only unless include_burstable is set.

provider.description: cloud provider, e.g. AWS, Azure, AlibabaCloud, GCP; omit for all

country.description: ISO country code to restrict regions, e.g. US, CN, SG

continent.description: restrict to a continent: NA (North America), SA, EU, AS (Asia), AF, OC (Oceania)

near.description: free-text place (city/region) to find nearby regions, e.g. Singapore, Tokyo, us-east-1

charge_type.description: pricing model: on_demand, subscription, reserved, or spot

term.description: for reserved/subscription: contract length, e.g. 1 or 3 (years)

payment_option.description: for reserved: all_upfront, partial_upfront, or no_upfront

gpu_model.description: GPU model to match, e.g. A100, H100, T4

include_burstable.description: also return burstable (CPU credits/baseline: AWS t3, Azure B, Alibaba t6, Huawei t6/at7) and shared-core (GCP e2-micro, Linode/Vultr shared CPU) instances; excluded by default because their price buys a CPU baseline, not a full core

query.description: substring match on instance type name

max_hourly_usd.description: maximum price in USD per hour

limit.description: max rows to return (default 20, hard cap 50)

tools.name: compare_snapshots
tools.description: Compare snapshot (快照) storage cost across clouds: the USD $/GiB·month to store snapshot data, per region (also given as the cost of a 100 GiB snapshot/month). Snapshots are billed flat per GiB — no type/IOPS dimension like disks. Filter by provider/region/country/continent/near; cheapest first.

continent.description: NA, SA, EU, AS, AF, or OC

near.description: free-text place to find nearby regions, e.g. Singapore

tools.name: get_instance
tools.description: Full detail for ONE instance: all charge types (on-demand, subscription, reserved, spot) with their prices. Identify it by provider + region + instance_type (from a prior search).

tools.name: list_db_categories
tools.description: The database knowledge layer: cloud database CATEGORIES with when-to-use guidance and each cloud's equivalent product. Use this to pick the right kind of database for a scenario, then map it across clouds. Categories: relational (RDS), cloud-native relational (Aurora-class), cache (Redis), document (MongoDB), key-value/wide-column (DynamoDB-class), data warehouse/columnar (OLAP), specialized (time-series/graph). Each has positioning, use_cases, not_for, cross-cloud products, pricing_model (instance vs capacity), and comparable (whether prices can be compared cross-cloud — instance-based yes, capacity-based no). Pass a category id to get just one. Pricing per product is a separate (upcoming) tool.

category.description: optional category id to fetch just one: relational, relational_cloudnative, cache, document, keyvalue_widecolumn, olap, specialized

tools.name: list_facets
tools.description: List the valid filter values: providers, GPU models, charge types, payment options, and the geo vocabulary (continents + countries). Call this first to know what to filter on.

tools.name: list_regions
tools.description: Map fuzzy geography to concrete region codes. Filter by continent (NA/EU/AS/...), country, or 'near' a place (e.g. near='Singapore' returns nearby regions across all clouds, sorted by distance). Use this to turn 'near Singapore' / 'North America' into regions, then pass those to the price tools.

continent.description: NA, SA, EU, AS, AF, or OC

country.description: ISO country code, e.g. US, JP, SG

near.description: free-text place; returns regions near it sorted by distance, e.g. Singapore

limit.description: max regions to return (default and cap 50)

tools.name: price_changes
tools.description: What changed in cloud server pricing recently: new instance types or regions (new), delisted (removed), price increases/cuts (price_up/price_down), and sale prices against an unchanged list price (discount/discount_end). new/removed are whole instance types; a type appearing in or leaving one region is available/unavailable (only when asked). Recorded at each daily sync in the native currency (FX moves are not changes); hourly prices with USD equivalents. Newest first, biggest moves first.

days.description: look back this many days (default 7, max 90)

kind.description: new, removed, price_up, price_down, discount, discount_end, available, or unavailable; omit for all but available/unavailable (region-level stock churn)

instance_type.description: substring of the instance type, e.g. c7 or a100

tools.name: search_databases
tools.description: Search managed-database (RDS-class) pricing across clouds, ranked by USD/hour (also monthly = ×730). For the instance-based, cross-cloud-comparable categories: relational (MySQL/PostgreSQL), later cloud-native/cache/document. Filter by engine, min/max vCPU & memory, deployment (single/multi_az), provider, region/country/continent/near, charge_type. Answers 'cheapest managed MySQL with ≥4 vCPU / 16 GiB in Singapore'. Use list_db_categories first to pick the right category. Set storage_gib to add storage to the monthly total. Coverage: AWS (RDS/Aurora and more engines), Azure, GCP, AlibabaCloud, TencentCloud, HuaweiCloud/HuaweiCloudIntl.

country.description: ISO country code, e.g. US, SG

continent.description: NA, SA, EU, AS, AF, or OC

near.description: free-text place to find nearby regions, e.g. Singapore

category.description: db category id (default relational); see list_db_categories

deployment.description: single or multi_az (HA); omit for any

storage_gib.description: if set, add this much DB storage to the monthly total (instance + storage)

storage_type.description: storage type for storage_gib: gp3 (default), io1, io2, magnetic, aurora

tools.name: search_disks
tools.description: Search cloud block-storage (云盘/disk) pricing across 13 clouds, ranked by $/GiB·month (USD). Filter by category (hdd/standard_ssd/balanced_ssd/perf_ssd/ultra), provider, region/country/continent/near, charge_type (on_demand/subscription), and min_iops — min_iops keeps only disk types whose IOPS cap sustains the workload (the common DB/RDS bottleneck). Returns the cheapest N (max 50).
